patch_description: Restore the stronger two-basis-layer structure of the best prior candidate while regularizing both layers through graph-orbit parameter sharing. Add the missing boundary RY rotations, tie symmetry-related initial amplitudes, replace the three-body interaction with the two omitted graph edges, and use a full post-entanglement RY/RZ layer instead of only two RX gates. Tying both RZ layers should preserve useful output-basis expressivity with fewer parameters than the 180-parameter prior candidate, potentially improving validation accuracy, loss, and generalization.
